Model Property Exported Macros

group MODEL_PROPERYTY_MACROS

Model property identifiers.

Defines

MODEL_PROPERTY_INVALID 0x00

Invalid property.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_AMBIENT_LUXLEVEL_ON 0x002B

Ambient light level when on.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_AMBIENT_LUXLEVEL_PROLONG 0x002C

Ambient light level during prolong phase.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_AMBIENT_LUXLEVEL_STANDBY 0x002D

Ambient light level during standby.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_LIGHTNESS_ON 0x002E

Lightness level when on.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_LIGHTNESS_PROLONG 0x002F

Lightness level during prolong phase.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_LIGHTNESS_STANDBY 0x0030

Lightness level during standby.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_REGULATOR_ACCURACY 0x0031

Light control regulator accuracy.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_REGULATOR_KID 0x0032

Integral gain for dimming control regulator.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_REGULATOR_KIU 0x0033

Integral gain for undimming control regulator.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_REGULATOR_KPD 0x0034

Proportional gain for dimming control regulator.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_REGULATOR_KPU 0x0035

Proportional gain for undimming control regulator.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_TIME_FADE 0x0036

Fade time for transition.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTROL_TIME_FADE_ON 0x0037

Fade time when turning on.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_TIME_FADE_STANDBY_AUDIO 0x0038

Fade time for standby with audio.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_TIME_FADE_STANDBY_MANUAL 0x0039

Fade time for manual standby.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTROL_TIME_OCCUPANCY_DELAY 0x003A

Delay time for occupancy sensing.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTORL_TIME_PROLONG 0x003B

Prolong time after occupancy sensed.

MODEL_PROPERTY_LIGHT_CONTROL_TIME_RUN_ON 0x003C

Run time after occupancy.

MODEL_PROPERTY_MOTION_SENSED 0x0042

Detected motion level.

MODEL_PROPERTY_MOTION_THRESHOLD 0x0043

Threshold for motion detection.

MODEL_PROPERTY_PEOPLE_COUNT 0x004C

Number of people counted.

MODEL_PROPERTY_PRESENCE_DETECTED 0x004D

Detection of presence.

MODEL_PROPERTY_PRESENT_AMBIENT_LIGHT_LEVEL 0x004E

Current ambient light level.

MODEL_PROPERTY_TIME_SINCE_MOTION_SENSED 0x0068

Time passed since last motion sensed.

MODEL_PROPERTY_PRECISE_TOTAL_DEVICE_ENERGY_USE 0x0072

Precise total energy use of the device.

MODEL_PROPERTY_SENSOR_GAIN 0x0074

Sensor gain value.
